items.title: AI agents & RAG chatbots
items: Chatbots that answer from your PDFs, manuals and help docs
Every answer shows the source it came from
Agents that answer customers, qualify leads and update your CRM
Runs on your website, in your own tools or as an API
Private setups on your own server when data can’t leave
items.desc: An assistant that knows your business. It answers your customers or your team from your own documents and shows the source. When the answer isn’t there, it says so.

items.title: Automation workflows
items: n8n or Python workflows that connect the apps you already use
Emails, invoices and PDFs handled without copy-paste
Follow-ups by email, SMS or WhatsApp
AI steps for writing, sorting and pulling out details
Alerts and approval steps when a person needs to check
items.desc: Repetitive work taken off your team’s plate. I map the steps you do by hand today and automate them. Checks and alerts make sure nothing fails silently.

items.title: Document processing & OCR
items: Scans, receipts and invoices turned into structured data
OCR for printed and handwritten text, in English and Bangla
Checks that flag misread numbers before they reach your books
Exports to Excel, QuickBooks or your own system
Private setups that run fully on your own machine
items.desc: Paperwork turned into data you can use. Each document is read, checked and sent where you need it. Anything uncertain is flagged for a quick review.

items.title: Computer vision & ML
items: Custom models that detect, count or check things in photos and video
Real-time analysis of camera feeds
Prediction and classification models trained on your data
Explainable results, so you can see why the model decided
Delivered as an API, a web demo or inside your app
items.desc: Models built and tested on your own data. You see the accuracy numbers before launch, and get a deployed system your team can use.
